captions.instagram:
Class 11–12 Maths · Limits, Derivatives, Integrals
Maths, visualised #2 · All of calculus in one curve 📈

1️⃣ Limit: zoom in on any smooth curve and it starts to look straight (×64 here).
2️⃣ Derivative: that straight bit's slope. Watch the secant shrink onto the tangent: 0.745 → 0.502 → 0.437 → 0.436.
3️⃣ Integral: cut the area into thinner and thinner strips: 4, 8, 16, 64… and the total closes in on the exact area, 2.883.
One idea behind all three: zoom in.

On your syllabus: Class 11 Limits & Derivatives, Class 12 Calculus, JEE Main every year.
